title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurateurs adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses that they love. As Toast continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced Solutions Engineer to help us continue to grow internationally expanding into mid - market and enterprise accounts.

Hybrid, Toronto-based - with some travel to customer sites as needed.

About this role:

• Assist Sales teams in presenting the Toast product and platform to prospects and be able to demonstrate the value of a complete solution to each buying persona

• Become a subject matter expert on Toast products with complete knowledge of the technologies, application software, and integrated partners, and future product roadmap

• Work closely with Sales Enablement regionally to provide training and product expertise

• Communicate with Toast product teams to clearly communicate gaps in product/market fit to drive strategic investments

• Attend trade shows and other events as a Toast brand ambassador

• Must have ability to work closely with Product Management, Sales Enablement, and Marketing teams

• Drive cross functional collaboration across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

• Use restaurant industry knowledge / experience to consult with prospects on how Toast can help them outperform their peers

Do you have the right ingredients:

• Presentation Skills: Executive presence and the ability to articulate complex products and ideas with clarity, and handle complex customer communications fluently while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.

• Strong understanding of APIs (coding skills not required)

• Sales Experience: 3+ years of sales experience in a closing or closing support role within the Restaurant/Hospitality segment.

• Collaborative: Highly collaborative, serving as a trusted partner to sales, onboarding, and product teams, with strong problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

• Industry Experience: Must have experience with cloud POS systems, ideally within the Restaurant, Hospitality, or related industry. Experience with multi-location brands, enterprise/franchise IT systems, or complex organizational structures is highly desirable.

• Must be willing to perform nationwide travel to support business needs.

Special Sauce (non-essential skills, nice to have):

• Hospitality Experience: Must have experience working in hospitality in some capacity, giving you the ability to understand the challenges our customers face quickly.

• Toast Product Knowledge: Prior experience with Toast POS is preferred, within sales, implementation, training, or support.

• Must have the ability to work with minimal supervision: This role will require working independently as the first member of the team within the UK region.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at  https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits .

title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our team and culture make us unique - we’re driven by impact and growth, where every one of us strives to learn and excel. Recognised by Sifted’s Rising 100 https://sifted.eu/rankings/b2b-saas-rising-100-2024 and LinkedIn's Top Startups https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-20-aufstrebende-unternehmen-bjd0c/, we’re here to help propel your career and together, make Moss a lasting success.

Our Talent Acquisition team is searching for a Talent Acquisition Partner. You will play a pivotal role in helping Moss attract and hire the right talent for our our teams across Europe. Reporting to the TA Director, you will join a team of five Talent Acquisition Partners across Berlin and London, covering every market and every role up to C-suite.

Your responsibilities 

- Sourcing, screening & managing candidates  - identify, attract and engage with talent by using different sourcing techniques and channels. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience.

- Business Partnering - Own full-cycle hiring for your vertical end to end, from sourcing through offer, across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies.

- Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Share sourcing techniques and hiring intelligence with the wider TA team across verticals and markets.

- AI & Tooling - Contribute to making us more efficient and faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, chatGPT, n8n).

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

- Track record sourcing and closing high-calibre and hard-to-reach candidates, including through sourcing and direct outreach.

- Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter, ideally hiring across multiple functions/locales.

- Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them).

- Fluent in English (C1 minimum). Other languages, esp. German, a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- Inquisitive mindset - you ask sharp, insightful questions to really understand stakeholders and candidates

- Good judgement - you weigh information and observations to make sound judgement calls in ambiguous situations.

- Trustworthy and credible - you manage expectations, and build relationships based on a desire to help and support.

- Adaptive communication - you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and this enables you to guide, advise, and influence those you engage with.

The interview process will include an online assessment as an initial step, followed by an Intro Call, Hiring Manager Call, a Live Case Study and a Final In-person Interview in one of our offices.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 5,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, Gusto and Auto1, Moss has raised €200+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. Moss is backed by the most renowned tech investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star and Portage.

We’re building the AI-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth!

We’re building the AI-driven future of customer success, from retention to growth! Gainsight is the AI-powered retention engine behind the world’s most customer-centric companies. The Gainsight CustomerOS platform orchestrates the customer journey from onboarding to outcomes to advocacy. More than 2,000 companies trust Gainsight’s applications and AI agents to drive learning, adoption, community connection, and success for their customers. To explore how our suite of solutions is shaping the future of customer success, check out the link https://www.gainsight.com.

About This Role:

We’re looking for a full-time Senior Manager, Office of the CSO to join our Security team reporting to the Chief Security Officer. This role is a remote role based in the USA.

In this role, you'll play a key role in building Gainsight's security trusted-advisor function by supporting enterprise sales engagements, articulating Gainsight's security posture to CISOs, CIOs, and executives, and building out the program alongside the Chief Security Officer. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-growing, cloud-first environment and enjoys working cross-functionally with teams like GTM, Engineering, and Security. The ideal candidate brings strong skills in security operations and engineering, enterprise sales enablement, and executive communication and storytelling.

What You'll Do:

- Support GTM and Customer Service for all security concerns with our prospects, customers and partners

- Build out the success criteria for supporting the business

- Work closely with engineering and security to help define the product roadmap based on customer needs.

- Attract, mentor, and retain a world-class team of security strategists. Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous learning to meet the evolving needs of the organization

 

This role may require occasional travel (up to 10-20%) for team meetings, training, or company events. This is not a complete list of responsibilities, and the scope of the role may evolve with the needs of the team and business.

What We're Looking For:

- 5+ years of Security Leadership

- 7+ years of experience with compliance, security engineering and application security

- Proven experience supporting enterprise sales cycles or acting in a customer-facing advisory role.

- Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical executive audiences.

- Strong presentation, storytelling, and influencing skills.

Nice-to-have skills or experience:

- Experience managing a security team supporting GTM

- Experience developing whitepapers, and point-of-view content on modern security architectures and trends.

- Security Certifications (CISSP, CISA, CISM etc.)

Why You’ll Love It Here:

Gainsight is a place where innovation is shaped through collaboration, curiosity, and a shared focus on solving real-world problems. With a growing suite of products across customer success, product experience, community, education, and AI-powered relationship intelligence, we continue to evolve with the needs of our customers. When people with diverse strengths, a strong sense of community, and true passion for our mission come together, they drive greater impact and create lasting value. What underpins it all is a culture that offers the stability, trust, and support that people need - not just to do the job, but to show up as themselves and feel connected to the work they do. Gainsters love working here for several reasons. Here are a few:

title: Strategic Supply Chain, Industrial Base Operations
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Strategic Supply Chain, Industrial Base Operations is a key strategic and operational role responsible for architecting, implementing, and governing priority rating frameworks (e.g., DPAS) and defense supply chain resilience across the enterprise.

As the company scales rapidly to support mission-critical defense programs, safeguarding material availability and accelerating delivery timelines are paramount. In this role, you will serve as the enterprise operational authority ensuring defense priority requirements are seamlessly integrated into procurement, ERP/MRP workflows, supplier contracts, and program delivery schedules. Partnering across Supply Chain, Program Management, Contracts, Legal, Engineering, and Government Relations, you will bridge the gap between high-level defense policy and tactical shop-floor execution-mitigating supply risk and strengthening our enterprise operating posture.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Defense Priority Governance & Strategy: Serve as the enterprise operational lead for defense supply priorities, partnering closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Contracts, Program Management, Legal, and Government Relations to drive operational execution and close critical supply vulnerabilities.

• Strategic Commodity De-Risking: Collaborate with Supply Chain teams to identify critical commodities and supply chain bottlenecks where priority ratings can mitigate material risk; proactively lead cross-functional initiatives to secure and apply these ratings across programs.

• Single Source of Truth & Data Architecture: Build, manage, and scale a centralized data repository capturing strategic commodities, program allocations, rating statuses, active purchase orders, supplier flow-downs, identified risks, and open corrective actions.

• Contract Flow-Down & Supplier Execution: Partner with tactical and strategic procurement teams to ensure priority ratings and mandatory flow-down requirements are accurately reflected on purchase orders and legally binding supplier commitments.

• Enterprise Systems & Workflow Integration: Collaborate with Business Systems, IT, and Operations to embed priority rating logic and traceability into core enterprise platforms, including ERP, MRP, P2P, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), and business intelligence dashboards.

• Executive Alignment & Reporting: Deliver high-visibility reporting and operational briefings to senior leadership, VPs, and stakeholders detailing rating coverage, process deficiencies, material exposure, and strategic decisions required.

• Enterprise Roadmapping & Operating Posture: Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership to establish annual supply priorities, assess corporate defense industrial base posture, and design continuous-improvement roadmaps to mature the company's operating model.

• Policy Translation & Process Scale: Translate complex defense regulations, statutory mandates, and industrial base policies into actionable business processes, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices, templates, and company-wide training programs.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations, National Security Policy, or a related f

THE POSITION
The Technology Operations Analyst serves as the business-facing operational lead for Deployment Solutions IT. This role owns request intake, governance administration, process design, documentation, onboarding readiness, knowledge management, change management, training coordination, and adoption. The position turns Deployment Solutions business needs into clear requirements, repeatable processes, documented playbooks, and measurable adoption outcomes.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
Governance and Intake Management:

• Own and maintain the Deployment Solutions IT request intake model for enhancements, client customizations, support process improvements, and onboarding needs.

• Facilitate prioritization, routing, decision tracking, and follow-up for Deployment Solutions IT requests.

• Maintain governance artifacts including intake logs, decision logs, action items, readiness checklists, and process documentation.

Process Design and Documentation:

• Design and document repeatable Deployment Solutions IT processes, SOPs, how-to guides, playbooks, and support procedures. Including assessment of legacy workflows and implementation of modern operating models leveraging AI-enabled capabilities, automation frameworks, and knowledge-driven solutions.

• Partner with application and technical analysts to convert recurring support issues into reusable knowledge content.

• Maintain Deployment Solutions IT knowledge resources, resource hub content, and ServiceNow support content.

Client Onboarding and Readiness:

• Coordinate onboarding readiness reviews, handoffs, communication needs, and support transition activities.

• Ensure onboarding documentation captures relevant policies, workflows, limits, audit needs, reporting needs, extracts, and integration dependencies.

Change Management and Adoption:

• Develop communication plans, training plans, launch readiness materials, and adoption support for Deployment Solutions technology changes.

• Measure usage, adoption, feedback, and self-service effectiveness.

• Support stakeholder engagement across Deployment Solutions, IT, compliance, finance, project teams, and end users.

• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

• All other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

• Travel 0-10%, as business needs require.

• Full-time role; standard work week with periodic flexibility for implementation support, client onboarding, or offshore coordination.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, operations, communications, healthcare administration, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

• 3+ years of experience documenting processes, facilitating requirements, managing stakeholder communications, and coordinating UAT or readiness activities.

title: Senior Embedded Engineer – Robotics & Sensor Systems
description:
ABOUT US

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network-combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The SmartMast™ is a sophisticated, vessel-mounted edge computing platform running a dense software stack on NVIDIA Jetson hardware in maritime environments: salt air, vibration, intermittent connectivity, and real operational pressure. We need a Senior Embedded Linux / Platform Software Engineer who can own the software that runs at the tip of our spear. You will build and maintain the embedded Linux platform that integrates HD cameras, radar, SDR, AIS receivers, GPS, and thermal sensors into a unified, AI-capable sensing system. You will work at the intersection of hardware bringup, ROS2-based sensor middleware, edge inference pipelines, and the cloud connectivity layer that gets data from the vessel to our analysts in near real time. This is complex, meaningful work, and it ships to sea.

- Own and evolve the embedded Linux platform for SmartMast edge devices.

- Debug production issues from field signals/telemetry, drive root-cause analysis, and ship durable fixes quickly.

- Partner closely with hardware, software, and operations teams to bring systems from lab to vessel deployment.

- Lead PTZ camera integration decisions spanning lens selection, sensor convergence/alignment, and stabilization tuning, and translate those tradeoffs into measurable improvements in edge ML performance (detection, classification, tracking robustness).

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience with robotics frameworks such as ROS/ROS2.

- Experience in mobile/embedded platform development, specifically with NVIDIA Jetson, CUDA, and Yocto.

- Familiarity with various sensors and hardware, including GPS, IMU, cameras, Radar, and weather sensors, as well as driver development for these devices.

- Experience with industrial PTZ network cameras and video streaming technologies.

- Hands-on experience with sensor fusion techniques (Kalman/EKF, particle filters, or learned fusion approaches) across radar, EO/IR, and positioning data.

- Expertise in developing and deploying AI/ML models for visual tasks, including detection, segmentation, and classification.

- Experience with OTA update systems and device fleet management at scale.

Board and Committee Support

• Draft and maintain minutes, resolutions, action items, and follow-ups.

Entity Management and Governance Records

Litigation and Insurance Claims Support

Cross-Functional Support, AI, and Administration

title: Paid Media Manager

We’re hiring a paid acquisition marketer to help scale our growth engine. You’ll build and optimize full-funnel campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, YouTube, and emerging developer-focused platforms-turning paid media investment into qualified signups, pipeline, and revenue.

This is a highly analytical, hands-on role with ownership spanning channel strategy, campaign execution, creative testing, landing-page experimentation, and measurement. You’ll work closely with creative, content, product marketing, sales, lifecycle, data, and engineering to improve performance at every stage of the funnel, from the first impression through downstream conversion.

The ideal candidate combines strong paid media expertise with commercial judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action. You’re comfortable managing meaningful budgets, digging into attribution and cohort data, and running structured experiments to uncover new growth levers. You’ll thrive here if you move quickly, communicate insights clearly, and are energized by the opportunity to go above and beyond when a high-impact opportunity arises.

What you’ll do

- Own and scale paid acquisition across channels including Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, YouTube, and emerging developer-focused platforms

- Build and optimize full-funnel campaigns that drive qualified signups, pipeline, and revenue, not just clicks

- Develop channel strategy across search, paid social, retargeting, and experimentation budgets

- Test ad copy and creative angles tailored to technical audiences.

- Partner closely with creative, content, and product marketing to ship high-performing ad concepts and landing page iterations

- Manage campaign structure, keyword strategy, audience segmentation, and bidding to improve CAC and payback

- Own measurement and attribution, with support from ops and engineering: tracking setup, conversion quality, offline conversion imports, and incrementality testing

- Analyze performance trends and communicate results clearly through dashboards, reporting, and weekly insights

- Run structured experiments to identify new growth levers (new audiences, formats, offers, onboarding flows)

- Collaborate with sales, lifecycle, and data teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates downstream

- Stay current on platform changes, AI-driven campaign formats, and new opportunities in the paid media ecosystem

You may be a fit if you have:

- Proven ability to manage meaningful monthly budgets and scale spend efficiently while maintaining performance

- Deep expertise in Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Performance Max) and at least one major paid social platform

- Strong understanding of funnel metrics: CAC, LTV, payback period, and conversion rates

- Experience with analytics and attribution tools.

- Highly analytical mindset with comfort in spreadsheets, cohort analysis, and performance modeling

- Ability to move fast, test often, and iterate based on data and user insight

- Comfortable working cross-functionally in a high-ownership, fast-paced environment

- Experience in B2B paid media.

- Willingness to go above and beyond-this isn’t a strict 9-5 role, and while we respect work-life balance, the right person is energized by the occasional late-night project or weekend ping if it means a big opportunity for the business.

description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

The Global Tax Team is seeking a hands-on indirect tax professional to help build and scale Reddit’s global indirect tax function. As Reddit continues to grow as a public company and expand its products and commercial offerings, this person will own critical elements of our US and international indirect tax operations, including US S&U tax and VAT/GST.

You will partner closely with the business to translate complex tax requirements into practical decisions, reliable systems, and scalable processes. In keeping with Reddit values, the successful candidate will operate with an open mindset, exercise sound judgment, and “value the human” in every interaction.

This position will report to the International Tax Senior Manager.

  Responsibilities:

• Manage key elements of Reddit’s global indirect tax function across B2B and B2C revenue streams, including US S&U tax, VAT/GST, DSTs, and other transactional taxes.

• Oversee indirect tax registrations, return compliance, payments, exemption documentation, taxability determinations, and related controls across multiple jurisdictions.

• Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and assess their impact on Reddit.

• Contribute to broader Global Tax Team priorities and ad hoc projects, flexing beyond the role’s core indirect tax responsibilities as business needs evolve. 

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Tax, Accounting, or a related field.

• 6+ years of indirect tax experience in public accounting and/or a multinational corporate tax function, including meaningful hands-on operational experience.

• Technical and operational experience with both US and international indirect taxes, including B2B and B2C transactions.

• Experience researching product and service taxability, registration and nexus obligations, place-of-supply rules, invoicing requirements, and exemptions.

• Experience supporting indirect tax compliance, accounting, audits, and controls across multiple jurisdictions.

• Ability to understand end-to-end transaction flows and convert tax requirements into workable processes, data requirements, and system configurations.

• Strong project-management skills and experience supporting system changes or other cross-functional initiatives.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain complex tax matters to non-tax stakeholders.

• Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in a fast-moving and evolving environment.

title: Technical Program Manager, Robotaxi
description:

As a Technical Program Manager for Robotaxi at Wayve, you'll own the programs that bring our robotaxi service to life - from vehicle and fleet readiness to on-the-ground launch and scaling in market. Based in Yokohama, you'll work across autonomy, vehicle software, hardware, operations, safety, and local partners to turn Wayve's AI Driver into a safe, reliable robotaxi service - keeping complex, multi-team, cross-geography delivery predictable in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. You'll often bridge Wayve's global R&D with local delivery in Japan. As the only TPM on the ground in Japan, this is a generalist role: alongside robotaxi delivery, you'll help support local vehicle programs across hardware and software as needed.

Your impact will be measured by your ability to deliver programs, drive efficiency, manage risk, and align execution with business goals. A successful TPM is a force multiplier - helping teams move faster, more effectively, and with purpose.

Key responsibilities:

- Drive program delivery: Own the lifecycle of robotaxi programs - from vehicle and fleet readiness to launch and in-market scaling - improving delivery through structured execution and coordination.

- Manage dependencies & risk: Track and manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs across autonomy, vehicle, operations, and safety - and escalate early with clear options.

- Coordinate across functions & geographies: Keep engineering, fleet operations, safety, and local partner teams aligned - bridging Wayve's global R&D with local delivery in Japan.

- Support launch & operations on the ground: Provide hands-on program support for robotaxi launch and in-market operations, on the ground in Yokohama.

- Strong project management: Skilled at planning, prioritising, and managing risk and dependencies across teams.

- Exceptional communicator & collaborator: Operating from a remote office, you keep distributed teams aligned across time zones - communicating with clarity, proactively and in writing - and influence without authority across all stakeholders.

- Cross-cultural & on the ground: Comfortable working across geographies and cultures, and hands-on with vehicles and operations in Japan; Japanese language skills a plus.

- Generalist range: As the only TPM in-country, comfortable flexing beyond robotaxi to support vehicle hardware and software programs; happy wearing multiple hats.

- Data-driven: Comfortable defining and using metrics to steer delivery and decisions.

- Growth mindset: Open to feedback and always looking to improve.

title: Staff, Software Engineer - Simulation Vehicle Modeling
description:
About the Company  

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business. A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners.  Now a part of the Daimler family , we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight. Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer. 

Meet the Team

 

At Torc, our simulation teams are building the foundation for AV 3.0 driver-out development and certification. This team serves as the critical technical interface between simulation/modeling and autonomy consumers. By ensuring model fidelity, coverage, and usability, the team plays a vital role in evaluating and advancing autonomous driving software. We support massive-scale, parallel execution for scaled verification and validation (V&V) and high-throughput reinforcement learning (RL) training. Ultimately, we provide the framework and tooling that serves Autonomy, Safety, and Release with shared artifacts, common metrics, and deterministic reproducibility.

 

What You'll Do

• Own and evolve the technical architecture for scalable vehicle modeling and simulation - extensible across vehicle types, sensor platforms, and fleet variability as Torc's autonomy program grows.

• Develop and own high-fidelity truck and vehicle dynamics models (longitudinal, lateral, and transient behavior) spanning nominal, off-nominal, and failure-mode simulation domains.

• Define and drive the statistical validation metrics that directly support Safety Case claims, ensuring model fidelity and coverage meet the bar required for driver-out certification.

• Design and scale robustness testing frameworks - including controller/planner interaction testing - to stress-test autonomy software at the fidelity and throughput required for large-scale V&V and RL training.

• Design, develop, and maintain high-fidelity simulation platforms used to validate autonomous driving software in closed-loop evaluation pipelines at scale.

• Partner with autonomy engineering teams to capture and implement vehicle model requirements supporting planning, controls, and system-level V&V activities.

• Own model capability communication, known limitations, and release notes to enable effective autonomy validation across consuming teams.

• Ensure vehicle model updates don't regress autonomy V&V system performance, using automated regression frameworks you help define.

• Execute full software development lifecycle activities primarily in C++ within a Linux environment and ROS/ROS2 tooling, applying Lean-Agile methodologies.

• Perform root cause analysis on complex issues surfaced in simulation runs and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

• Drive test plan design for data acquisition and telemetry supporting field data collection and vehicle model refinement.

• Set direction for system-level test plans and verification strategies across the simulation org.

• Communicate technical direction, design decisions, and blockers clearly at stand-ups, design reviews, and cross-org architecture discussions.

• Build and maintain collaborative relationships with OEM partners and simulation tool vendors to evaluate, integrate, and co-develop simulation capabilities.

• Mentor engineers across the simulation and autonomy domains and help raise the bar on code quality, process, and testing rigor.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field plus 10+ years of relevant experience; or Master's Degree in the above fields plus 7+ years; or PhD plus 3+ years.

• Deep proficiency in C++ (primary), Python for tooling, ROS/RO

description:

Location: France
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1-2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity
About the opportunity
CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.
The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.
As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.
How it works
If selected for the project:

• You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.

• Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.

• You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.

• You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1-2 hours.
You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.
Please note that this is a data validation activity only.
Requirements
To participate, you must:

• Be 18 years of age or older.

• Currently reside in France.

• Be an active debit and/or credit card user.

• Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.

• Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.

• Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.

• Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.

• Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent
Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.
Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.
If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you

Commercial Partnerships - Revenue & Lead Generation

title: Associate Security Engineer
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

As an Associate Security Engineer at Everpure, you will join the Global Information Security Office (GISO) and begin your security career alongside the engineers and architects who protect our global cloud, infrastructure, and platform environments. You will learn by doing: supporting real security work, automating the manual parts of it, and building the hands-on foundation that security engineering depends on.

This role is built for early-career engineers who are curious, methodical, and eager to be mentored, with a clear path toward deeper technical specialization over time. No prior professional security experience is required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support Day-to-Day Security Engineering: Assist with configuration, tuning, and routine health checks of security tooling across cloud and endpoint environments, working from documented runbooks and standards with guidance from senior engineers.

• Build Automation and Tooling: Write and maintain scripts (Python preferred) and small integrations that remove manual effort, including pulling data from APIs, generating recurring reports, cleaning up findings, and connecting tools to each other.

• Learn Detection and Telemetry: Work with log and telemetry platforms such as Splunk to run queries, validate data sources, and help investigate and document findings alongside Security Operations.

• Scripting Ability: Comfort reading and writing basic Python or a similar language, and the appetite to grow into production-quality automation.

• Analytical Problem Solving & Communication: Methodical approach to troubleshooting technical problems, combined with the ability to ask inquisitive questions, absorb feedback, and document technical processes clearly for cross-functional partners.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title: Cyber Security Engineer
Shift Timing- Rotational
Work mode- Remote, India
Role Overview:
We are seeking a Cyber Security Engineer with 10+ years of experience and strong expertise in endpoint security architecture, EDR, NDR, DLP, File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), and enterprise endpoint security controls.
This role focuses exclusively on design, deployment, configuration, tuning, and long-term maintenance of security platforms.
No SOC operations, threat detection, or incident response responsibilities.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Endpoint Security & EDR Engineering
· Design, deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise endpoint security platforms, including:
o EDR/EPP solutions: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Trellix/McAfee, Symantec
o Endpoint security controls: AV, host firewall, device control, disk encryption, and vulnerability agents
· Develop endpoint security configuration baselines and ensure consistent policy enforcement across Windows/macOS/Linux devices.
· Manage agent deployment, health monitoring, policy tuning, updates, and lifecycle maintenance using tools such as Intune, SCCM, GPO, or automation scripts.
· Integrate endpoint telemetry with other security platforms for visibility
2. Data Loss Prevention (DLP) - Engineering & Lifecycle Management
· Design, deploy, and maintain enterprise-wide DLP solutions such as (Microsoft Purview DLP (endpoint, cloud, email), Forcepoint DLP, Proofpoint Information & Email Protection, Zscaler / Cisco Umbrella DLP
· Configure DLP policies, detection classifiers, endpoint rules, cloud controls, and data-handling workflows.
· Manage DLP agents, infrastructure components, tuning, upgrades, and operational alignment with compliance/regulatory requirements.
3. Network Detection & Response (NDR) Engineering
· Architect, deploy, configure, and maintain NDR solutions such as: (Corelight, Darktrace, ExtraHop Reveal)
· Configure SPAN/TAP feeds, cloud sensors, routing integrations, and traffic ingestion pipelines.
· Maintain sensor coverage, policy configurations, version upgrades, and performance optimization.
4. File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) - Design, Deployment & Maintenance
· Implement and manage FIM platforms, including: (Tripwire, Qualys FIM, Wazuh, Defender, CrowdStrike)
· Configure monitored directories, change detection rules, baselines, and exclusions.
· Oversee FIM agent deployment, architecture, health, and maintenance across server and endpoint fleets.
5. Automation, Deployment & Platform Operations
· Automate deployment, configuration updates, and system health checks using:
o PowerShell, Python, Bash, API/Graph API
· Perform ongoing platform operations such as patching, upgrading, tuning, and configuration auditing.
· Maintain complete and up-to-date documentation including:
o Architecture diagrams
o Deployment methodology
o Standard operating procedures
o Version control and lifecycle plans
Requirements
Required Technical Skills:
· Hands-on experience with multiple EDR platforms (MDE, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, etc.).
· Strong understanding of enterprise DLP platforms (Microsoft Purview + Forcepoint/Symantec/Trellix/Netskope/etc.).
· Knowledge of NDR tools (Corelight, Vectra, ExtraHop, Darktrace).
· Experience with FIM solutions (Tripwire, Qualys, OSSEC/Wazuh, EDR-based FIM).
· Strong knowledge of endpoint internals (Windows, macOS, Linux), registry, services, event logs, and system processes.

title: Fraud Investigator
locationText: Chicago, IL; Denver, CO; Westlake, TX
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role 

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

Our mission is to safeguard the company’s assets and our customer’s accounts by relentlessly detecting and investigating fraudulent activities, ensuring the integrity and security of our Bank product.  We champion the prevention and detection of fraud, ensuring the highest standards of security and integrity. 

As a Bank Fraud Investigator, you will be responsible for investigating suspected fraudulent activities within the banking products. You will work closely with various departments to identify, prevent and resolve fraudulent activities involving accounts, transactions and other financial products.

Available shift

• Tuesday through Saturday; 11:00am - 8:00pm CT and 9am - 6pm CT on Saturdays

This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Westlake, TX and Denver, CO offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

• Investigate and mitigate bank and credit card fraud by analyzing suspicious activity across multiple payment rails, including debit and credit card transactions, and by reviewing potential identity theft, account takeover (ATO), wire transfer fraud, payment fraud, and check fraud.

• Analyze financial data, account history, and transaction records to identify irregularities, emerging fraud patterns, and potential policy violations.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Operations, to resolve fraud-related issues, ensure appropriate controls, and escalate cases as required.

• Conduct outbound contact with customers, merchants, or third parties to perform interviews, gather supporting documentation, and obtain evidence relevant to fraud investigations.

• Apply Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) requirements when reviewing, documenting, and reporting fraud-related findings, including accuracy, permissible purpose, dispute handling, and adverse action considerations.

• Maintain current knowledge of fraud typologies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices to support effective prevention, investigation, and response.

• Ensure investigations and resolutions comply with all applicable regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.

• Clearly, professionally, and timely communicate with customers to deliver an exemplary and compliant customer experience.

What you bring 

• Proven experience in fraud investigation, financial analysis, or a related role (1-2 years).

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

• Knowledge of fraud operations, regulations, and fraud prevention techniques.

• Ability to communicate clearly and effectively (written and verbal) with customers and internal teams.

• Ability to work independently and handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.

• Preferred qualifications: Certified in fraud examination (CFE) or a related credential, AML knowledge.

Artists shape culture. They spark conversation, create connection, and bring beauty into the world. Minted is where they come together to reach further. description:
What You Can Expect
In this role, you serve as the primary technical point of contact for Zoom's most strategic enterprise customers, owning integration challenges from first report to final resolution across Zoom's full suite of Video, Native, Mobile, and CoBrowse SDKs. Day to day, you partner with SDK engineering, Solutions Engineers, and CSMs to diagnose multi-layer technical problems, lead customer troubleshooting calls, and translate complex issues into documented solutions that millions of developers depend on. Candidates without hands-on experience reading and debugging code across JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python, or without direct API/SDK integration or troubleshooting experience, will find the core technical demands of this role difficult to meet. This is a strong opportunity for a technically grounded customer advocate ready to solve hard problems and make a measurable difference at scale. This role reports to a Manager, Technical Account Engineer.

About the Tea m
The API & SDK team serves as the embedded technical experts for Zoom's most demanding enterprise accounts, covering the full lifecycle of SDK and API integration challenges across Video, Native, Mobile, and CoBrowse SDKs. We collaborate closely with iOS, Web, and CoBrowse engineering alongside TAMs, CSMs, and Solutions Engineers to ensure end-to-end issue ownership and resolution. Our mission is to keep Zoom's most strategic customers running and make their developers' lives easier.
Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end technical support for enterprise customers integrating Zoom's Video SDK (Web, iOS, Android), Meeting SDK, Native SDK, Mobile SDK, and CoBrowse SDK into their products.

• Reproduce, isolate, and document customer-reported bugs using session logs, HAR traces, and SDK diagnostics, then drive resolution in close partnership with engineering.

• Lead technical troubleshooting calls with customer engineering teams to diagnose issues, provide workarounds, and coordinate fixes with Zoom SDK engineering.

• Translate customer pain into engineering action by filing detailed bug reports, advocating for feature requests, and ensuring fixes land in the right SDK release.

• Develop and deliver customer-facing technical documentation, architecture diagrams, migration guides, and release-impact assessments.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years of experience in developer advocacy, solutions engineering, or developer relations, with a focus on API/SDK integration, troubleshooting, or customer enablement

• Working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python, with comfort reading and debugging code written by others

• Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, OAuth 2.0 (Server-to-Server and Authorization Code), webhooks, and API rate-limit patterns

• Hands-on experience integrating or troubleshooting client-side SDKs (Web, iOS, or Android); experience with real-time communication SDKs such as WebRTC, SIP, or SRTP is a plus

• Ability to analyze network traces, console logs, HAR files, and crash reports to isolate and pinpoint root cause

• Proven ability to communicate with equal clarity to engineering and product audiences, with strong written and verbal English skills

• Experience with iOS (Swift/Objective-C), Android (Kotlin/Java), CoBrowse technologies, RTMS, media pipelines, or CI/CD frameworks for SDK releases is a bonus

Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.

We partner directly with engineering teams and technical leaders to integrate Codex into their software development lifecycle - from identifying high-impact use cases and designing AI-enabled workflows to implementation, evaluation, and scaled adoption. Our work helps ensure AI-powered software development is effective, reliable, secure, and deeply integrated into how engineering organizations operate.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced technical leader to join as Manager, Applied AI Engineering (Codex), leading a team of Applied AI Engineers responsible for driving successful Codex adoption across strategic customers. Your team will work hands-on with customer engineering organizations to design and build AI-enabled development workflows, solve complex implementation challenges, and establish scalable patterns for AI-powered software development.

As a manager, you will shape how these technical engagements operate at scale - setting strategy, coaching engineers, determining where the team can have the greatest impact, and ensuring consistently strong execution across customers. - Champion safe, reliable, and effective adoption of AI-powered development workflows across industries.
